summary: Surveyed all 177 listed files (176 Lean modules under Clean/ plus lakefile.lean) with byte sizes and a per-file grep count of Lean declaration keywords (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque/syntax/macro/elab/simproc/notation). 169 files have at least one declaration; the 8 zero-declaration files were read completely. The circuit, AIR, channel, table, gadget (SHA256, BLAKE3, Keccak, Poseidon, circomlib), spec, type, and utility modules carry definitions, specifications, and proofs and stay searchable. Test-data and test modules (Plonky3TestData, Plonky3MemoryTestData, ChunkProcessingTests, Utils/Test/*, TestWasm*) still hold Lean defs, theorems, and examples about the circuits, so they stay. Import aggregators (Clean.lean, Clean/Circuit.lean, Clean/Test.lean, Clean/Utils/Tactics.lean) stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007. Attribute-registration files (SimpGadget, SimpTable, ExplicitAttributes) define simp/label attributes with documentation and stay. The only exclusion is lakefile.lean, a Lake package configuration with no mathematical content. The six backends/plonky3 fixture generators excluded earlier are not in this unit's changed list.
